title: Salesforce Unveils AIforce and Koa Reasoning Model at Dreamforce 2026
excerpt: At Dreamforce Day 1, Salesforce launched AIforce, a live interface layer that takes CRM to any tool, and Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
body:
• Salesforce unveiled AIforce at Dreamforce 2026 on September 15, a "live interface layer" that pipes its data, workflows and governance into any tool — Claude, Slack or Lightning — ending the era of doing everything inside the CRM screen.
  • The company also launched Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron, designed to reason through complex multi-step business workflows inside a company's trust boundary.
  • Day-one announcements included a deepened Salesforce–Anthropic "Claudeforce" partnership, expanded ties with AWS and Google Cloud, and a Siemens industrial AI tie-up.
  • CEO Marc Benioff called it an "interface revolution": the future of enterprise software is composable, governed AI that comes to workers wherever they are.

Salesforce used the opening day of Dreamforce 2026 in San Francisco to redraw the boundaries of enterprise software, unveiling AIforce — a "live interface layer" that brings the full power of its platform to any interface — and Koa, its first CRM reasoning model, built on NVIDIA Nemotron.

"AI is creating an interface revolution," Salesforce chair and CEO Marc Benioff said. "We are combining model intelligence with all the context that customers have built into Salesforce to create an intelligent, dynamic, composable system that is securely governed, built with Zero Data Retention, and designed to work with the core systems that already run your business."

AIforce: Salesforce comes to you

For nearly three decades, getting anything done in Salesforce meant logging into Salesforce — navigating tabs and screens built for admins. AIforce flips that: it extends the company's data, workflows, business logic, semantics, permissions, security and governance to any AI interface. Employees who have never opened a dashboard can ask questions, update records and trigger workflows, grounded in real Salesforce data, inside the tools they already use.

The launch comes in three experiences: Claudeforce in Claude, Slackforce in Slack, and Agentforce Coworker inside Salesforce's own Lightning interface. With Claudeforce, businesses bring Salesforce data, context, workflows and business logic into Claude; Slackforce embeds CRM capabilities in Slack channels, including tools for developers working with AI coding agents; Agentforce Coworker acts as an AI teammate inside Lightning that reasons across activities, accounts and history and takes action within Salesforce permissions.

Koa: a reasoning model trained on how business works

Alongside AIforce, Salesforce and NVIDIA announced Koa, described as the company's first CRM-specific reasoning model. Built on NVIDIA Nemotron, Koa was trained on synthetic scenarios based on nearly three decades of Salesforce CRM data — not on customer data. Rohan Kumar, Salesforce's president and chief platform and engineering officer, said Koa embeds decades of enterprise business knowledge directly into the model, enabling it to reason through complex workflows while operating securely within a company's trust boundary.

"Built on NVIDIA Nemotron, this model brings together 27 years of Salesforce's product development and innovation in CRM with years of research. We believe it can be a game-changer for complex agents performing multi-step tasks."

— Rohan Kumar, President and Chief Platform and Engineering Officer, Salesforce

"Not a single byte of customer data was used to train this model," Kumar added — a deliberate answer to enterprise anxieties about AI governance. The company already uses Koa internally for employee engagement, Kumar said.

The partnership blitz

Day one also brought a flurry of alliances. The Salesforce–Anthropic "Claudeforce" partnership, announced on September 9 ahead of the conference, integrates Claude across the Salesforce ecosystem via the new AIforce UI harness, Headless 360, Data 360, Tableau and Slack — with Claude available inside Agentforce as the reasoning model for the Atlas Reasoning Engine. "Salesforce in Claude" launches with 37 prebuilt sales skills, including meeting prep, deal health review and pipeline review, available to select pilot customers with open beta in September 2026.

Salesforce and AWS expanded their partnership to put CRM data, AI agents and model choice directly inside AWS environments; Salesforce and Google Cloud moved to unify infrastructure and agents into one connected stack. Siemens and Salesforce deepened their AI partnership, bringing Agentforce into Siemens' industrial workflows for manufacturing and engineering teams. The company also pointed to new industry deployments of its agentic platform, including airlines such as Air India, which expanded its Agentforce customer-service deployment this month.

Why it matters

Dreamforce's theme was unmistakable: the agentic enterprise is moving from pilot projects to production, and the bottleneck is no longer the model but the interface — how workers and agents reach governed business knowledge. For Indian IT services firms and enterprise teams, which count among Salesforce's largest implementation partners and customers globally, the shift toward agent-based interfaces promises a new services wave: rebuilding workflows around AIforce's live layer rather than Salesforce's screens. The risk, as ever with enterprise AI, is execution: governed agents are only as good as the data hygiene beneath them.

What's next

Open beta for Salesforce in Claude opens this month; Agentforce Coworker and the AIforce harness roll out through the autumn. Watch whether Koa can match generalist reasoning models on complex multi-step CRM tasks — and whether enterprises trust it enough to let agents act, not just assist. If Benioff is right, the CRM screen itself is about to become optional.
